name: Dooks Golf Club
note: Par 71. The par is solid but the stroke index genuinely conflicts between sources: the club site (dooks.com) and the shared aggregator feed (18birdies/golfsherpa) disagree on most holes, and the course is not in the USGA NCRDB. No stroke index could be transcribed without picking a winner, so it lands cardless; the first scorecard photo settles it. No USGA course rating or slope published.
